label: D2 after a rewarded trial, when the agent chose a2 and reached S1 (rare), mid-episode (trials 10-59)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost only when the input shows last action a2 and state S1, i.e. an a2 -> S1 rare transition (97% of mass), and only when the previous trial was rewarded. All of these are observed at D2. Without an episode-position condition it reaches recall 0.93 but precision 0.31 (F1 0.47). Activity has a strong, unexplained dependence on position in the episode: it is almost silent before trial 10 and after trial 60, with none after trial 70. Restricting to trials 10-59 raises dev F1 to 0.68 (P 0.56, R 0.86, mass 0.91). So the unit is probably sensitive to slow drift in the hidden state rather than to anything the task presents. Activity also sits in a narrow band of the model value output (7.13-7.54) and of strongly a2-favoring policy logits. The rare top activations come from a1 -> S1 common transitions just after a streak of a2 choices, which is consistent with a reading of reaching S1 while the agent prefers a2. It does not fire at D1 or GO, on S2, or after unrewarded trials. Precision is still incomplete: many qualifying a2 -> S1 steps stay silent for reasons I did not find.
